name: Lighter
description: Lighter is a perpetual futures exchange built as a zk-rollup: order matching and liquidations run off-chain and are verified on-chain with zero-knowledge proofs. Deposits settle through its Ethereum contract, and the app also takes deposits from other EVM networks through a universal deposit address.
description_zh: Lighter 是一个以 zk-rollup 形式构建的永续合约交易所：订单撮合和清算在链下运行，并通过零知识证明在链上验证。存款通过其以太坊合约结算，应用还可通过通用存款地址接收来自其他 EVM 网络的存款。

geo_site.method: The API rejects requests with geo_restriction_not_allowed ("You are accessing Lighter from a restricted jurisdiction") and the app shows a geo-blocked banner; the Terms log the IP to enforce access restrictions. The blocked countries are those where GET /api/v1/geoLocation answered error 20558 to the live probe (see the observations; 2026-10-12: 14 of 62 countries, among them US, CA, GB, RU, UA, CN); the Terms name 14 jurisdictions.

tos.restricted: US, Canada, UK, China, North Korea, Russia, Ukraine, Cuba, Iran, Venezuela, Sudan, Belarus, Myanmar, Syria

notes: Closed frontend; SDKs are open. The geo restriction is an API error code the app turns into a banner. Wallet login goes through Dynamic, whose public project settings carry enableExternalWalletOnTransactionSanctions: true (effect not verified).

api_probes.name: geoLocation
api_probes.note: The API's geo check, polled by the app; error 20558 turns into the geo-blocked banner.
